restaurant.name: Royal Dine
restaurant.description: Royal Dine is a premier multi-cuisine family restaurant located in the heart of Kasaragod, Kerala. Renowned for authentic Arabian Alfaham grills, fragrant dum biryanis, rich North Indian curries, and sizzling tandoori delights, Royal Dine offers a luxurious yet welcoming atmosphere for families, food lovers, and travelers.
highlights: Signature Charcoal Grilled Alfaham & Pepper Alfaham
Spacious Family Seating with Air Conditioning

verifiedReviews.author: Mohammed Ashif
verifiedReviews.comment: One of the finest dining spots on Chandragiri Road. Their Pepper Alfaham is simply unmatched—tender, smoky, and bursting with flavor. Excellent family cabin seating and polite staff.

verifiedReviews.author: Anjali Nair
verifiedReviews.comment: Had an amazing family dinner. The Chicken Dum Biryani was fragrant and delicately spiced, not oily at all. The ambience is neat and air conditioning makes it very comfortable.

verifiedReviews.author: Kishore Kumar
verifiedReviews.comment: Great food and prompt service! The Mutton Rogan Josh paired with hot tandoori naan was top-notch. Very reasonable prices for such generous portion sizes.

verifiedReviews.author: Farhan K.
verifiedReviews.comment: The Arabian grill section is fantastic. Quick service, juicy Alfaham chicken with kuboos and garlic dip. A must-visit stop when passing through Kasaragod.

featuredDishes.name: Signature Charcoal Alfaham
featuredDishes.description: Traditional Arabian marinated chicken slow-grilled over charcoal embers, served with fresh kuboos, mayonnaise, mint dip, and pickled veggies.

featuredDishes.name: Fiery Black Pepper Alfaham
featuredDishes.description: Tender chicken infused with cracked Malabar black peppercorns, roasted garlic, and Arabian spices with an irresistible smoky crust.

featuredDishes.name: Royal Chicken Dum Biryani
featuredDishes.description: Aromatic long-grain basmati cooked in dum with marinated tender chicken cuts, golden fried onions, and whole spices. Served with raita and pickle.

featuredDishes.name: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh
featuredDishes.description: Tender mutton simmered in an aromatic crimson gravy of Kashmiri chilies, fennel seeds, and spiced yogurt.

featuredDishes.name: Butter Garlic Naan
featuredDishes.description: Hand-stretched leavened bread baked in tandoor, topped with roasted minced garlic, fresh coriander, and melted butter.
